title: Agent Squad manifest
description: Schema for an Agent Squad bundle's manifest.json — the package descriptor. Per-agent runtime config lives in agents/<id>/agent.json, validated separately by agent.schema.json. Source of truth for validation is apps/marketplace/src/services/manifest.ts — this file mirrors it for bundle authors.

author.description: GitHub username or org. v1: pancake-official.

skills.description: Bundle-relative paths to squad-wide skill files.

items.description: Kebab-case agent id, unique within the squad. Each id must have a matching agents/<id>/agent.json file.

agents.description: List of agent ids declared by this squad. Per-agent config lives in agents/<id>/agent.json.

workflows.description: Outcome-typed entrypoints the squad publishes — its public interface. The cofounder delegates by creating a board ticket that names a workflow id + inputs and assigns it to the workflow's agent; the agent runs it via its own skills. Inline metadata (not file paths) so the cofounder's catalog can be built without reading extra files.

id.description: Stable workflow id, lower-kebab/dotted, e.g. eng.triage_issue. Unique within the squad.

summary.description: One line the cofounder reads to match intent → workflow.

inputs.description: Map of input name (lower_snake_case) → rich descriptor. The cofounder writes its dispatch brief from these — treat them as the workflow's API docs. Omit when the workflow takes no inputs.

type.description: The value shape. "enum" requires the enum array.

description.description: One line of plain English: what this input means and what the squad does with it.

example.description: A concrete example value the cofounder can crib from when briefing.

required.description: Default true. Set false for optional inputs (then `default` is honored).

default.description: Value used when required is false and the brief omits this input.

enum.description: Legal values — only allowed (and required) when type is "enum".

outcome.description: The defined outcome / done-state, e.g. "issue labeled with a P0–P3 criticality + assessment filed".

outcome_schema.description: Optional JSON-Schema-shaped object the workflow's complete_task result must conform to. Opt-in; the gateway validates the result against it and re-routes mismatches through fail_task (category outcome_invalid). Passed through transparently by the marketplace.

agent.description: The squad agent that runs this workflow — must be one of manifest.agents. The cofounder assigns the ticket to this agent.

secrets.description: Vault keys this workflow needs at runtime. Each entry must reference a key defined in required_vault_secrets (the squad-level registry, where {key,label,type} live once). Agents fetch a secret only when running a workflow that lists it.

tools.description: Tool permissions this workflow needs at runtime. Each entry must also appear in required_tool_permissions (the squad-level registry the install grants).

required_vault_secrets.description: The squad's secret registry — each {key,label,type} is defined once here so onboarding/install knows what to collect. Workflows reference these keys via their `secrets` array; an agent needs a secret only when running a workflow that lists it.

required_tool_permissions.description: The squad's tool-permission registry — the union of what its workflows need; the install grants these. Workflows reference these keys via their `tools` array.
Enforced — each value must be an accepted Pancake tool key. See docs/bundle-reference.md for the canonical list.

infra_tool_permissions.description: Squad-infra tools used at onboarding/heartbeat time rather than inside any workflow (e.g. mcp-installer). Each entry must also appear in required_tool_permissions; listed keys are exempt from the unreferenced-tool warning.

min_pancake_version.description: Informational only in v1 — the pod has no semantic version.
